basis.governing_question: How can MetalCo sell directly to small and mid-size contractors in Portugal and Spain through an online marketplace without losing its regional distributors?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define a tested marketplace blueprint for small and mid-size contractors and a plan for the pilot in one region.

gate.label: Go/no-go on pilot
gate.decision: Approve the blueprint and pilot plan to start the pilot in one region?

phases.name: Pilot
phases.objective_one_line: Test the marketplace with contractors in one region and show whether repeat orders come without losing distributors.

gate.label: Scale-up decision
gate.decision: Approve the business case and roadmap as the input to the 2027 budget round?

workstreams.name: Marketplace hypotheses
workstreams.answers: Which assumptions on contractor demand and distributor roles must the marketplace blueprint test?
activities: Frame hypotheses on each marketplace blueprint component
Interview the CEO and Head of Sales on goals and limits

deliverables.name: Hypotheses on each marketplace blueprint component

workstreams.name: Demand and channel evidence
workstreams.answers: Do small and mid-size contractors in Portugal and Spain want to buy directly, and how do distributors react?
activities: Interview small and mid-size contractors on how they buy
Interview regional distributors on channel risks and needs
Analyze order data from the existing B2B portal

deliverables.name: Contractor and distributor evidence on the hypotheses
Wireframe prototype of the contractor marketplace

workstreams.name: Blueprint and pilot plan
workstreams.answers: What marketplace model, with what role for distributors, goes into the pilot, and how will it run?
activities: Synthesize evidence into a tested marketplace blueprint
Detail the pilot scope, region and success measures
Align distributor roles with the distributors council

deliverables.name: Detailed plan for the pilot in one region

workstreams.name: Pilot target contractors
workstreams.answers: Which small and mid-size contractors in the pilot region should the marketplace reach first?
activities: Interview contractors and distributors in the pilot region
Analyze order data by customer size and region
Select the first contractors to invite to the pilot

deliverables.name: Target contractor group for the pilot

workstreams.name: Distributor & KPI alignment
workstreams.answers: How are the success measures and distributor roles agreed so no regional distributor walks away?
activities: Agree pilot KPIs with the steering group
Agree with regional distributors how they take part
Track distributor contracts and reactions during the pilot

deliverables.name: Pilot KPIs agreed with the steering group
Agreed role of regional distributors in the pilot

workstreams.name: Pilot marketplace launch
workstreams.answers: Does a first marketplace version, launched to a small contractor group, produce repeat orders?
activities: Build the first marketplace version for pilot contractors
Launch to the target group after the readiness review
Track orders and repeat orders from pilot contractors

deliverables.name: First marketplace version launched to pilot contractors
Pilot results against the two success criteria

workstreams.name: Scale-up business case
workstreams.answers: What would scaling the marketplace beyond the pilot region require and return, given pilot results?
activities: Evaluate pilot results against the agreed KPIs
Compare options for scaling beyond the pilot region
Draft the business case and implementation roadmap

deliverables.name: Scale-up options and distributor channel model
Business case with implementation plan and roadmap

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align on goals, scope and working method
events.decision: Confirm the goals, scope and success criteria for the engagement?
agenda: Present the engagement plan, phases and steering moments
Align on the success criteria for the pilot region
Confirm access to people and data for the first weeks

events.label: Check-in: evidence so far
events.purpose: Review early evidence and adjust direction
events.decision: Confirm the hypotheses and evidence to carry into the blueprint?
agenda: Review the hypotheses on each blueprint component
Present evidence from contractors, distributors and order data
Confirm what the blueprint must still test

events.label: Go/no-go on pilot
events.purpose: Decide whether to start the pilot
events.decision: Approve the blueprint and pilot plan to start the pilot in one region?
agenda: Present the blueprint with tested hypotheses
Review the pilot plan and the wireframe prototype
Decide whether to go ahead with the pilot

events.label: Workshop 1: pilot readiness
events.purpose: Review readiness before the pilot goes live
events.decision: Confirm the pilot can go live with the target group and agreed KPIs?
agenda: Present the target contractor group and the agreed KPIs
Review the agreed role of regional distributors in the pilot
Decide whether the pilot can go live

events.label: Workshop 2: scale-up options
events.purpose: Review pilot progress and scale-up options
events.decision: Confirm which scale-up options go into the business case?
agenda: Review the first marketplace version and early pilot activity
Present the scale-up options and the distributor channel model
Decide which options to detail in the business case

events.label: Scale-up decision
events.purpose: Sign off results and business case
events.decision: Approve the business case and roadmap as the input to the 2027 budget round?
agenda: Present pilot results against the two success criteria
Review the business case with implementation plan and roadmap
Confirm next steps ahead of the 2027 budget round

architect_notes: Estimate: the brief gives 20 weeks in total and no stage lengths, so the 6-week Design and 14-week Pilot split is assumed.
The marketplace is a new build, so the plan ends at the pilot; the rollout after it is not in these phases.
